name: TimeSnap
author: Third-party plugin author
description: Snap the time bar's playhead to the real timestamps of loaded features, with a per-layer availability histogram.

descriptionFull.title: TimeSnap reads the times off features that time-enabled layers hold client-side, shows how many of them fall inside the current time window as a per-layer histogram, and lets you step the playhead to an actual event time instead of scrubbing blindly through empty stretches.
